title: Unit codes at the scan
description: A chain's own unit codes, read by the till's scan: one record per unit (its unique code, its item, its batch and whether it is still Available or Sold) and a scan source over that table. Scanning a unit's code lands its item with its batch; a Sold unit is refused. Data only: no service, nothing leaves your site. The scan source is on from the install; a chain may set Record the code as to one of its own active line attributes so the code rides the sale's line. The partner's own service writes a unit back to Available after a return and to Sold after a sale (from the event feed). Every right a role has is written out (read, write, create, delete, report, export, share, print, email).
